text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inside the bus heading to summer training 
camp, there was a slight feeling of 
anxiety regarding the upcoming battle 
against Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright says she's fine, but there 
is no concrete strategy to counter that 
otherworldly running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To take on such formidable opponents, it 
seems we will need to unite the wisdom of 
the Mejiro family.
